seo.title: Museums in Puno: the must-visit museums on Lake Titicaca | Travel guide
seo.description: Museums in Puno do not promise spectacle. They offer something better. Within a few blocks, ancient cultures, colonial life, republican memory, and the everyday pulse of the Altiplano intersect.
